name: All Collectibles
summary: Master directory for all 200+ hidden items, graffiti murals, sunken caches, and stunt ramps scattered across Vice City and the state of Leonida.
description: Exploration across the vibrant landscapes of Leonida rewards inquisitive players with a diverse assortment of collectibles. From neon-lit urban rooftops in downtown Vice City to alligator-infested waterways in the backcountry, collecting every item unlocks exclusive customization, cash bonuses, and progress toward 100% completion.
reward: Exclusive custom vehicles, character outfits, weapon skins, and $1,000,000 bonus cash upon full completion.
locationsSummary: Distributed across Vice City Metro (80), Port Gellhorn (40), Leonida Keys (40), and Northern Swamplands (40).
